name: Heartlands Diary
summary: The starter region. From mining copper in the eastern hills to slaying greater demons in the deepest dungeon.

tasks.description: Mine a copper ore and a tin ore.
Smelt a bronze bar at the town furnace.
Smith a bronze dagger on the town anvil.
Catch a shrimp at the Heartlands fishing spot.
Cook a shrimp without burning it on the town range.
Kill a chicken, cook it, and bury its bones.
Chop a normal tree and light the logs in Heartlands.
Complete the Heartlands Patrol quest.
Buy a bronze sword from Kael's Smithy.
Pickpocket a man or woman in Heartlands town.
Visit all 4 Heartlands shops in a single trip.
Complete 1 easy clue step in Heartlands town.
Spin flax into bowstring at the Heartlands spinning wheel.
Climb the Heartlands lookout tower for the first time.
Plant a guam seed in the Heartlands herb patch.

easy.reward: Heartlands cape (easy) + emote: tip hat. Diary lamp (easy) granting 2,500 XP to any skill.
easy.perk_description: 10% chance of double yield from Heartlands farm patches; Heartlands teleport (3/day).

tasks.description: Kill a Hill giant in the eastern hills.
Smith an iron dagger on the town anvil.
Complete the Missing Miner quest.
Catch a trout at the fly fishing spot.
Cook a trout on the town range without burning it.
Reach the top of the Heartlands rooftop agility course.
Clean a grimy guam leaf.
Mix an attack potion.
Plant and harvest a potato from the Heartlands allotment.
Sell an item on the Grand Exchange.
Craft a dragonstone ring with a Heartlands teleport charge active.
Complete 3 medium clue steps within Heartlands.
Smelt a steel bar at the town furnace.
Participate in a Guardians of the Rift minigame round.
Chop and burn a willow log within Heartlands.

medium.reward: Heartlands cape (medium) + bank teleport unlock. Diary lamp (medium) 7,500 XP (level 40+ skill).
medium.perk_description: Bones drop noted from Heartlands monsters; Heartlands teleport unlimited.

tasks.description: Kill a lesser demon in the Heartlands dungeon.
Complete the Forge of Duran quest.
Craft a sapphire ring (crafting 20 required).
Fletch a maple shortbow and string it.
Complete a full lap of the rooftop course without failing.
Bury a dragon bone on the Heartlands altar.
Use the Heartlands teleport spell.
Pickpocket a paladin.
Kill a Moss giant with magic.
Catch a lobster at the Saltbrine coast and cook it in Heartlands.
Use the Lunar Humidify spell on a Heartlands farming patch.
Complete 3 hard clue steps within Heartlands.
Fletch 100 yew longbows in a single trip.
Complete a Pest Control round in Heartlands harbour.
Explore the Heartlands hidden crypt (use an unlocked shortcut).

hard.reward: Heartlands cape (hard) + GE teleport, +10% Heartlands shop discount. Diary lamp (hard) 15,000 XP (level 60+ skill).
hard.perk_description: Heartlands GE teleport always available; herb patches 10% slower disease; +5% mining XP at all Heartlands rocks.

tasks.description: Defeat Forgefather Duran in under 2 minutes.
Build a gilded altar in your player-owned house.
Complete a full herb run (harvest from all 7 patches).
Craft 100 nature runes in a single trip.
Smith a rune platebody from scratch (mine ore, smelt, smith).
Kill a Greater demon with only magic.
Chop a yew tree in the Heartlands.
Catch and cook a shark.
Mix a saradomin brew.
Complete every Heartlands quest.
Complete a GE flip generating 1M+ profit in a single transaction.
Complete 3 elite clue steps within Heartlands.
Achieve 99 in a Heartlands-trained skill (cooking, smithing, or mining).
Complete a Champion's Challenge in the Heartlands arena.
Reach the summit of the Heartlands lookout tower at dawn (exploration).

elite.reward: Heartlands cape (elite — recolour menu), instant altar access in player house, gilded shoulder pauldrons. Gilded faith (stat-bonus reward): +50% prayer XP at all Heartlands altars (Ardougne Elite analog, retained from previous design). Chance at Heartling pet (1/5000 per Heartlands boss kill after completion). Diary lamp (elite) 50,000 XP (level 75+ skill).
elite.perk_description: All Heartlands altars give +50% prayer XP (stat-bonus); instant teleport to any Heartlands shop; 5% chance of double drops from Heartlands monsters; Heartling pet eligibility.
